comment: Checkpoint registry — single source of truth for which adapters are at which lifecycle state. Per slm-learning-082: candidate, staging, canonical, rejected, archived. Daemon (gad-monorepo phase 147) MAY auto-move low-blast-radius specialists from candidate to staging. NEVER auto-promotes to canonical. Updated by scripts/delta/promote_atomic.py and the (planned) registry-update hook in eval_candidate.py.

candidates.notes: Hypothesis-testing run per SL-T-04-03 + slm-learning-049. Risk: catastrophic forgetting per slm-learning-024/026.
auto-staging allowed per slm-learning-082 (low-blast-radius specialist); canonical promotion still manual.

router_classifier.blocked_on: gap G1 — gad-monorepo lib/routing/decision-log.cjs has zero callers; no training data.

attention_classifier.notes: Per slm-learning-072: rule-based v1 first; learned classifier becomes a Phase 05 candidate after we have a labeled golden set.

skeleton_classifier.blocked_on: no skeleton-marked corpus yet — gated on backward sweep per slm-learning-067.

kael_intent_classifier.notes: Phase K2 candidate per slm-learning-084 — replace heuristic with SLM classifier once accept/reject trace data accumulates.
